business_logic_findings.title: Potential Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) / Missing Access Control
business_logic_findings.reasoning: Function 'handle_user_profile' accepts sensitive parameter ['user_id'] but lacks authorization decorators or explicit verification calls.

taint_violations.title: Command Injection via System Call
taint_violations.remediation: Sanitize and validate all external input before passing to sensitive system/database calls.

header_findings.title: Missing HSTS Header
header_findings.remediation: Configure 'Strict-Transport-Security' in web server response headers.

header_findings.title: Missing Clickjacking Protection (X-Frame-Options)
header_findings.remediation: Configure 'X-Frame-Options' in web server response headers.

header_findings.title: Missing Content Security Policy (CSP)
header_findings.remediation: Configure 'Content-Security-Policy' in web server response headers.

header_findings.title: Missing MIME-Sniffing Protection (X-Content-Type-Options)
header_findings.remediation: Configure 'X-Content-Type-Options' in web server response headers.

header_findings.title: Permissive CORS Configuration Check Needed
header_findings.remediation: Configure 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' in web server response headers.
